answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the cipher is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the ledge of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. The voyage ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 1braw.
